HomePage.description: An interactive preview of Seneca MD's next generation of digital patient experiences.

Hero.subheadline: AI-powered patient journeys — from first inquiry to full recovery.

TheGap.line1: You built the finest hair restoration clinic in Europe.
TheGap.line2: But your patients' digital journey still begins with a contact form — and ends with an email.

ProductShowcase.mainTitle: Three ways we transform the patient experience
ProductShowcase.mainDesc: Each solution is built to work independently or together — creating a seamless digital ecosystem around your clinic.
ProductShowcase.p1Title: From first click to booked consultation — one AI conversation
ProductShowcase.p1Desc: Imagine a patient lands on your site at 2 AM from Dubai. Instead of filling out a form and waiting days for a reply, they chat with an AI assistant that speaks their language, answers their questions, assesses their photos, and books them into your next available slot. By morning, your team has a pre-qualified lead with visual analysis ready.
ProductShowcase.p1RiskDesc: Architected with a mandatory 'Human-in-the-Loop' safeguard, preventing autonomous diagnosis and ensuring MDR compliance. The AI acts as a pre-qualification (AI Triage) and Agentic Booking tool, minimizing response times while human advisors retain the final authority. System operates entirely within EU Data Residency.
ProductShowcase.p2Title: Their recovery companion. Your recurring revenue engine.
ProductShowcase.p2Desc: Surgery is day one. The real relationship is the 12 months that follow. MySeneca keeps patients engaged with milestone tracking, photo progress monitoring, and direct messaging with your care team. And when they need their next bottle of finasteride or scalp care serum — it's one tap, auto-delivered, auto-billed.
ProductShowcase.p2RiskDesc: Post-op photo collection is protected via a specialized DPIA and explicit consent (GDPR Art. 9). Simultaneously, the application natively integrates a subscription e-commerce model, transforming aftercare into a predictable stream of Recurring Revenue and drastically increasing the Customer Lifetime Value.
ProductShowcase.p3Title: What if patients could see the result before the surgery?
ProductShowcase.p3Desc: The biggest barrier to conversion isn't price — it's uncertainty. Nano Banana uses generative AI to show patients a realistic preview of their post-procedure appearance. Conservative, medically-grounded projections designed so that clinical reality always exceeds the digital preview.
ProductShowcase.p3RiskDesc: Generative AI is a powerful sales catalyst. To mitigate the risk of unrealistic expectations, the tool requires strict disclaimers ('illustrative digital simulation') and a robust Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with the provider, functioning strictly as an interactive consultative asset.
